purpose: External methodological context for the frozen sectoral_financial_positions public-data boundary. This file does not alter any RMD gate, tolerance, source formula or readiness status.

sources.title: Euro area and national quarterly financial accounts – Quality report 2024
relevant_findings: Internal consistency covers accounting identities and hierarchical relationships between aggregates and components.
Aggregation consistency requires the transmitted total economy to equal the sum of sectors/subsectors.
Horizontal consistency requires the sum of financial assets to equal the sum of liabilities for each financial instrument.
Romania satisfied 96% of the validation rules over Q4 2012 to Q2 2024 in the report's Annex 1 table.
The report describes minor internal-consistency exceptions for Romania and notes that national financial accounts are derived from multiple source systems and may require balancing/reconciliation.

sources.title: Sector accounts
relevant_findings: Sector accounts are disseminated as a complete and consistent quarterly framework covering resident institutional sectors and their interactions with the rest of the world.
The concepts and definitions are aligned with ESA 2010.

relationship_to_rmd_evidence.interpretation: The ECB methodology independently supports using aggregation and horizontal consistency as hard diagnostics. It also establishes that small national validation inconsistencies can exist in published/transmitted financial accounts. This context supports freezing the observed RMD discrepancy as a public-source limitation rather than allocating residuals, but it does not establish an alternative numeric tolerance and therefore cannot promote the reference mode.
